title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：rope　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rope 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the builder ① tied the rope that no assistant in the site would have counted, and he said the tying was the whole of the month. The ② rope, meaning the cord itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a rope, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ rope in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ rope at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rope, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the builder said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rope was the whole of the matter, meaning the bond and not the cord. The ⑥ rope, meaning the bond and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; rope, he said, is either something you tie or the only word that means both a cord and a bond. He said the bond is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ rope had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ rope of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of counting; rope, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rope I remember is the cord counted in the plan, which closed in 1973 and is still counted as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ rope, my mother said in 1975, is the only cord that improves by being counted; every rope, she said, is a bond that has agreed to look like a cord. She said the bond was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 绳子（指工地里每一根旁边的那一根）
B. n. 绳子（指那根绳子本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：tie the rope 系这一根绳子
D. n. 绳子（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 绳子之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的绳子之事）
F. n. 绳子（指施工图里写到、被清点的那一根）
G. n. 绳子、维系（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 维系（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tied the rope that no assistant in the site would have counted
The rope, meaning the cord itself and not the beam
the rope at the far wall
the rope was the whole of the matter
the rope had become a line in a plan
The rope of the whole thing
A rope, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: tie the rope 意为“系这一根绳子”，1966 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯清点的一根绳子做了一遍。
rope 意为“绳子”，指那根绳子本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
rope 意为“绳子”，指工地里每一根旁边的那一根，每一根旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
rope 意为“绳子”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rope 意为“绳子、维系”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这根维系就是那件事的全部。
rope 意为“维系”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那根绳子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rope 意为“绳子”，指施工图里写到、被清点的那一根，到 1971 年这一根成了施工图里的一行。
rope 意为“绳子之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的绳子之事是一处工地和三个月份的清点。
rope 意为“绳子”，我记得的是施工图里清点过的那一根，1973 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一根。
rope 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，绳子是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的绳子。

那根绳子，指的是那根绳子本身而不是短短的横梁，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。（rope）
